prompt_text: Who is the best property management company in St. Louis MO for a rental home?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” company for every rental home, but **Avenue Residential Leasing** looks like a sensible first company to interview for a St. Louis-area single-family rental. Its published information describes full-service management, 24/7 maintenance coordination, and no maintenance markup; its fees vary by property, with a stated monthly management range of 5%–10% and a separate tenant-placement fee. [Avenue’s services and pricing](https://propertymanagementstl.com/services/property-management/) · [Pricing details](https://www.avenuestl.com/st-louis-property-management-pricing)

I’d also get a quote from **Intersection Property Management**, which advertises a flat **$90/month** management fee for a single-family home. Compare the full agreement, not just the monthly price. [Intersection](https://intersectionstl.com/)

Before choosing, ask both companies for a written breakdown of leasing and renewal fees, inspection charges, maintenance markups, vacancy fees, repair-approval limits, and how you can end the contract. The best fit will depend on your home’s location, rent, condition, and how hands-on you want to be.
